settings.title: Program
settings.description: The program to debug. When this is empty, Lithe looks next to the open file (app.c → app) and in build/ under the project, and uses the first runnable file it finds. Build one with debug information first, for example: clang -g main.c -o main (gcc -g works too). Debugging needs lldb-dap: install the Xcode Command Line Tools with xcode-select --install, or install Xcode, and Lithe finds it by itself.
